main_text.p: Et excerpit humanis usibus apta, & accommodat se vulgarium captui: Ubi indoles illa durior, sedentario & cunctante labore compingit illiberale quiddam & exoticum, importunum commercio, nisi boni judicii discerniculo, atræbilis integram libram excribaveris & quincuncem.

Pro opposita parte. Regalis illa indoles & imperio nata, quæ torvo venerabilis silentio, virilem præfert sine nutu vultum, sine gesticulatione manum, quæ specie ipsâ proscribit è vicinia sua proterviam, & pudore multat levitatem, & suo se tuetur contra contemptum pondere: At indoles illa tractabilis & benignior (iniquum hoc quidem, ita tamen est, ô Superi) ipsis displicet obsequiis, ipsâ sui copiâ & suavitate vilescit: Non indignatur & cedit: Facilis præ-
main_text.notes: Left-margin fragments are show-through or the neighbouring page and are omitted. Doubtful: "opposita" contains a stray character, read as opposita; "atræbilis" is the printed form of atræ/bilis split across a line end.
